subject: [AMBER] Do RTX 3080Ti video cards supported by the amber20?

messages.author: Wei Jiao
messages.body:
Dear members:
I want to ask an urgent question whether the RTX 3080Ti video card supported by the amber20. Because I bought the RTX 3080Ti video card, but I just did not find this video card in the supported hardware (
http://ambermd.org/GPUHardware.php
).
I am looking forward to hearing from you.
Best regards,
Wei

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Wed, Nov 02, 2022, Wei Jiao via AMBER wrote:
>
>I want to ask an urgent question whether the RTX 3080Ti video card supported by the amber20.
I don't have personal experience, but given that 3080 is supported, and that
1080Ti and 2080Ti work, I think you are pretty safe in assuming that 3080Ti
will also work.
....dac

messages.author: Alessandro Contini
messages.body:
Hi,
I'm using Amber20 on a RTX3070Ti and it works fine, so I would expect that 3080Ti will work as well.
Best,
Alessandro
